notes.title: Grid Slayer 1.2 update!
notes.notes:
Huge update!

All of the art for the Cards has been updated!!!

This update also comes with a new Enchant, Map, Perk, 2 new Enemies and 3 new Cards. Unlock the 'Biomancy' Insight to access it all.

Enjoy! Let me know what you want to see in the next update.

notes.notes:
- Fixed master volume slider.

Not getting reports of any other bugs but I'm sure they're out there. Please let me know if you find any.

Up next:
I'll continue to monitor the game and fix any bugs that are reported. Tentatively saying the next big update should be up by the end of March 2022. Taking feedback on what to prioritize for this update so get involved to have a say.

notes.notes:

Let me know if you find anything else!

notes.title: Grid Slayer 1.0 Release Date and future Roadmap!
notes.notes:
I am proud to announce that [b]Grid Slayer will be leaving Early Access on February 2nd 2022, 2/2/2022. [/b]The game is so much better off thanks to your feedback and guidance during Early Access. I've had an absolute blast working on this from start to finish and I hope you all have just as much fun playing the finished product.

It doesn't end here. For as long as people keep playing and for as long as there are good ideas, I will keep growing Grid Slayer so there's always an excuse to come back for a little splash of turn based action. Here is our roadmap for 2022.

[b]Grid Slayer road map:[/b]

[b]Q1 2022:[/b]
True final boss fight is added and 1.0 balancing is finalized.
Grid Slayer leaves Early Access.
Spanish, German, Russian and Chinese translations. More to come in future.

[b]Q2 2022:[/b]
Endless mode:
A quick and casual mode that only ends when you lose.

[b]Q3 2022:[/b]
Dark Magic:
Necromancy and summoning themed content pack.

[b]Q4 2022:[/b]
Biomancy:
Healing and plant themed content pack.

notes.title: Grid Slayer's first big update!
notes.notes:
It's the first big update for Grid Slayer, and it is huge.

[b]Main features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Insights come with new Enemies, Enchants, Perks and some game changing difficulty modifiers.
[*] You can now save between battles in a campaign.
[*] You can now mouse over an enemy to predict their move direction.
[*] Optimization. The game should run a lot smoother and be less prone to bugs.
[*] A whole lot of new music from Mike Panayiotis.
[*] A whole lot of new art from Maly Miller.
[/list]

I'm consistently taking feedback from players for balance changes and features for the game.

The next update will be the 1.0 version and will contain the true final boss fight as well as some other goodies. Come join the discussions forum here on Steam or the [url=https://discord.gg/jquJTZRE7W]discord[/url] and let me know what you would like to see in Grid Slayer 1.0 and beyond.

We are also working on translation into several languages.

If you want instant access to new content and fixes as they happen, feel free to install the beta build.

notes.title: Hotfix 2nd November 2021
notes.notes:
Some more bug fixes.

Everything should happen in proper sequence now regardless of how chaotic things are.

Please let me know if you find any bugs in this build.

notes.title: Hotfix notes for October 29th
notes.notes:
Fixing bugs reported by the community.

Also:

notes.title: First big update for Grid Slayer
notes.notes:
[b]Big update.[/b] I got some great feedback and advice from the players and having my game out there for people to see has a way of lighting a fire under my bum. So we have a juicy update for you to start the new week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219236/7fd40b1049cbc69e794008608d2cb99153aad39f.gif[/img]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
- Mouse Camera control!
- Buttons for End Turn, Skip Draft and to progress dialogue.
- You can now play the entire game without touching your keyboard.
- 21:9 support.

[b]Accessibility:[/b]
- New 'Warning' signs no longer just colour coded.

[b]Graphics:[/b]
- New 'map loading'! Instead of a boring white wash to transition between scenes, the pieces now fall from the sky one by one.
- Missing Arachnomancy assets replaced.
- Nicer High Peak, Ice Cave and Volcano Tiles.
- Missing Mod assets replaced.

[b]Optimization:[/b]
- Fixed some runtime issues people were having on various systems by optimizing the code.
- Fixed issues with obstacles not quite interacting properly if there is a lot going on. Now I welcome you to try Earthquake in the Alchemist's Lab and see how it goes.
- Fixed it so a Counter attack will successfully interrupt an enemy's Dash attack.
- There should be fewer frame skips when everything catches fire at once.
- Quite a few bug fixes.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
- Water Soul now requires you to be on a Wet Tile.
- Crown of Silver now starts you with 5 Endurance.
- Crown of Gold now increases the Coin you earn.
- Lots of changes to various cards to make them more balanced.
- Lots of various little fixes here and there.

[b]Next update:[/b]
Our artist, my wife, Maly Miller, is hard at work drawing the missing Card art and getting ready for the next batch so we can release some more content.

Meanwhile, I will be balancing the game, taking feedback, and making sure it is as smooth and as polished as can be. So don't be shy with your feedback!

The next big update will be in December. There may be smaller updates and hotfixes between now and then.

If you've been enjoying the game, it helps us tremendously if you write a review.

Cheers!
